facts.summary: VAL-083 failed to beat standard of care, development suspended · Phase 2/3 GBM AGILE · VAL-083 in glioblastoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: preliminary topline results from the Glioblastoma Adaptive Global Innovative Learning Environment (GBM AGILE) study showed that VAL-083 did not perform better than the current standards of care in glioblastoma.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: VAL-083 did not perform better than the current standards of care in glioblastoma.
evidence.safety: These topline results included preliminary safety data for VAL-083 that was similar to that of the current standards of care used to treat glioblastoma.
evidence.program_discontinued: With this study outcome, Kintara is suspending the development of VAL-083 and turning its focus to its second program, REM-001.
